claim: To connect to a provisioned or serverless Amazon MSK cluster through private bootstrap brokers, the cluster must meet a list of requirements; among them, multi-VPC private connectivity must be enabled for the IAM access control method, and the cluster needs a resource-based policy that grants the Firehose service principal permission to invoke the Amazon MSK CreateVpcConnection API operation.

evidence.quote: To connect to a provisioned or serverless Amazon MSK cluster through private bootstrap brokers, the cluster must meet all of the following requirements.
Multi-VPC private connectivity must be enabled for the IAM access control method.
You must add to this cluster a resource-based policy which grants Firehose service principal the permission to invoke the Amazon MSK `CreateVpcConnection` API operation.
